posts.text:
Faith and freedom are at the very heart of why I am running to be Florida's next governor. It’s truly an honor to be endorsed by Florida Faith and Freedom.

In his letter to the Corinthians, Paul wrote, 'where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.' That Spirit guided our forefathers as they dared to forge a new country founded on the inalienable rights given to us by our Creator, not the government.

As Governor, I will and fight for our God-given rights on behalf of every Florida family

We can’t forget what we’re up against this November. We must win.

posts.text:
Senator Albritton has done excellent work leading the conservative cause as President of Florida's Senate, and I am glad to have him in my corner as we work to beat Florida Democrats this November. 

Ben's experience and support will be critical as we fight to defend Florida's agricultural community, deliver for rural Floridians, and make sure the Florida Dream is accessible for all.

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America does the Lord’s work to protect unborn children across America, and I’m deeply honored to have their support. 

In the Florida State House and in Congress I have never wavered in protecting the unborn — as Governor, I never will. 

Together, we will keep Florida the most pro-family state in the country.
